csv_scope_of_work: The Mobile Airport Authority, Mobile, Alabama, is requesting sealed submittals for professional services in the following categories: Civil Engineer Environmental Engineer Airport Planner Architect Appraisal Specialist Disadvantaged Business Enterprise (DBE) Specialist The firms selected will serve as consultants of record and provide professional services for federal/state grant projects, and locally funded projects planned from 2026 to 2029, or at the pleasure of the Mobile Airport Authority. All qualifications will be submitted on standard GSA Form SF330. Copies of this form is available upon request. A pre-submittal orientation meeting is scheduled for Friday, June 5, 2026, at 2:00 p.m. at the Mobile Airport Authority BFM Terminal at 2455 Michigan Avenue, Mobile, Alabama 36615. Qualification submittals for Civil Engineer, Environmental Engineer and Airport Planner will include experience and qualifications in the following areas: planning, engineering design, material testing, field surveys, constructions plans and specifications, construction engineering services and inspection, environmental permitting, analysis, planning and design, financial planning, and program services. Qualification submittals for Architect will include experience and qualifications in the following areas: terminal building construction modification and expansion; roadway and parking lot improvements; industrial, commercial buildings and hangar construction; and other similar projects which may be required during the three-year period. Qualification submittals for Appraisers will include experience and qualifications in the following areas: survey and development of airport property map; analysis and appraisal of property rights for acquisition; and planning long term land acquisition program. Projects that may be undertaken over the next three years consist of the following: Runway and taxiway construction; Land acquisition and relocations; Runway and taxiway lighting and marking; Wetlands and stormwater study update; Ramp and apron construction and rehabilitation; Drainage studies and construction; Environmental mitigation, study and implementation; Demolition, clearing, grubbing, grading and drainage; Highway, road, bridge and drive design and construction; Perimeter road and security fence construction; Airfield, cargo, terminal area and landside design; Procurement of airport support equipment and vehicles; DBE Studies; Design of terminal and landside facility construction; and Sustainability projects
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Materials Testing, Land Use Planning, Planning/Master Planning, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Utility Engineering, Stormwater, Transportation Planning

title: Mobile Airport Authority Professional Services
short_description: RFQ for multi-disciplinary airport planning, engineering, architecture, and related professional services.
project_scope: Framework-style selection of consultants of record for airport-related projects planned from 2026 to 2029 for the Mobile Airport Authority. Potential tasks include runway and taxiway construction; runway and taxiway lighting and marking; ramp and apron construction and rehabilitation; drainage studies and construction; wetlands and stormwater study updates; environmental mitigation, studies and implementation; demolition, clearing, grubbing, grading and drainage; highway, road, bridge and drive design and construction; perimeter road and security fence construction; airfield, cargo, terminal area and landside design; terminal building modification and expansion; roadway and parking lot improvements; industrial, commercial building and hangar construction; land acquisition and relocations; airport property mapping and appraisal; DBE studies; procurement of airport support equipment and vehicles; and sustainability projects. No specific dimensions, spans, or building areas are stated.
services: Professional services in multiple categories: civil engineering, environmental engineering, airport planning, architecture, appraisal, and DBE specialist services. For civil/environmental/airport planner roles, services include planning, engineering design, material testing, field surveys, construction plans and specifications, construction engineering services and inspection, environmental permitting, analysis, financial planning, and program services. For architecture, services include terminal building modifications and expansions, roadway and parking improvements, and industrial/commercial/hangar projects.
relevance_explanation:
- This is a broad multi-disciplinary airport consultant RFQ rather than a defined structural project.
- It appears to function as an on-call/framework arrangement for many future tasks, which is generally less attractive for sbp.
- Most listed services are civil, environmental, planning, appraisal, and airport-related general consulting.
- Although bridge and terminal-related tasks are mentioned, no specific bridge, long-span roof, or architecturally demanding structure is defined.
- Potential building and hangar work could involve structures, but the notice provides no concrete structural scope, size, or innovation focus.
- Therefore relevance for sbp is low but not zero due to possible future structural components.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated. The notice is an RFQ for multiple future airport projects from 2026 to 2029, including runways, taxiways, terminal modifications, roads, bridges, hangars, drainage, and sustainability projects. Because it covers numerous undefined projects without quantities, dimensions, or program values, a realistic single construction cost estimate is not possible.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. This is a qualifications-based selection for consultants of record across several disciplines and multiple future projects, so no realistic sbp fee estimate can be derived from the notice.
references_qualifications: Submittals must be provided on GSA Form SF330. Civil Engineer, Environmental Engineer, and Airport Planner submissions must demonstrate experience in planning, engineering design, material testing, field surveys, construction plans and specifications, construction engineering services and inspection, environmental permitting, analysis, planning and design, financial planning, and program services. Architect submissions must demonstrate experience with terminal building construction modification and expansion, roadway and parking lot improvements, industrial and commercial buildings, hangar construction, and similar projects. Appraisal submissions must demonstrate experience with airport property mapping, appraisal of property rights for acquisition, and long-term land acquisition planning.
